# Support

## Getting help

- Read the [README](../README.md) for installation and usage.
- Use the [development discussions forum](https://xenforo.com/community/forums/xenforo-development-discussions.34/) for usage and help questions.
- For bugs or feature requests, search [existing issues](https://github.com/xenforo-ltd/xf-cs-fixer/issues), then open a [new issue](https://github.com/xenforo-ltd/xf-cs-fixer/issues/new) if needed.

## Reporting bugs

Include:

- Minimal PHP input and the actual and expected formatted output.
- The active configuration or affected rules.
- The package version, upstream PHP CS Fixer version, and PHP version.
- The exact command and relevant output or error.

Do not include tokens, passwords, or private source code in reports or output.

## Security issues

Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Instead, contact the
maintainers privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to propose changes.
